description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a product engineering team building software for complex legal work. You will take on end-to-end engineering challenges across document workflows, AI integrations, APIs, and user-facing features, helping make important work more reliable and practical.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build reliable APIs, backend services, and document-processing workflows for research, drafting, review, and finished work product.

 - Take core product features from technical design through release and iteration, working with engineers and legal domain experts.

 - Integrate AI capabilities into practical workflows, with a focus on output quality, speed, and dependable behavior.

 - Improve the usability of complex document tasks through clear interfaces and full-stack collaboration.

 - Translate user needs into focused engineering plans and communicate technical tradeoffs.

 - Improve performance, investigate production issues, and strengthen testing, monitoring, and code quality.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Typically 3 to 10 years of experience shipping and maintaining production web applications or services.

 - Strong programming skills in a modern language such as Python or TypeScript, along with sound software design fundamentals.

 - Experience with APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, or distributed backend systems, including building reliable APIs and services.

 - Experience building document-processing workflows and integrating AI or LLM capabilities into production systems.

 - A practical approach to testing, code review, debugging, and improving systems after launch.

 - Background in frontend development, complex data and security needs, workflow automation, or legal technology is relevant.

 - Clear written communication and the ability to take ownership and collaborate across a distributed team.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Annual base salary is $180,000 to $250,000 USD, depending on relevant skills, experience, and role scope. The role offers substantial ownership and influence over product decisions. Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

Remote, United States.
